to my cubby

Happy 21st Birthday

I used to think flowers were impractical. Something people buy that just ends up fading away, forgotten in a vase after a few days.

Then you happened.

You showed me something different. How you preserve and love the things you're given, how you actually hold on to the things that matter and don't let them fade away. And while I was choosing these flowers for you, I learned and experienced that I wasn't just picking randomly. I was seeing the beauty in each one, choosing carefully, because it was for you. I never understood that before, now I do.

The first bouquet I've ever given, and it's yours.

21 years of you existing in this world, and I'm just glad I get to be here for this one. Happy birthday, bossing. You made birthdays worth celebrating again.

I love you, cubby.

October 3 🌹
